bio:
Sebastián Blanco (b. 1998) is a Costa Rican cinematographer whose work explores people and the ways their surroundings shape and affect them. Growing up in Costa Rica, surrounded by tropical landscapes, he developed an instinctive comfort working in and responding to natural spaces. His visual language was also shaped through skateboarding, developing an intuitive sense of rhythm and awareness of his surroundings. His career began in still photography, which continues to inform his approach to the moving image.

His work moves fluidly between documentary, fashion, music, and narrative, embracing spontaneity and allowing the environment to guide the image. He is drawn to unexpected moments, subtle gestures, and the atmosphere of a place.

He was part of the ASC Vision Mentorship Program and is currently based in Mexico City.
